name: Badge
summary: Information the system set and the reader can't change: a state or category in words, a count, a "new" dot, a status dot with words, or a person's presence; on its own or pinned to the corner of an icon, button or avatar. Not for a value someone picked or can remove (a Chip), an action (Button) or navigation (Link). Never takes focus. One component for what other systems call badge, lozenge, label, state label, counter, status light and indicator.
a11y: A `span` whose words are read as text. A count, dot or presence carries `label` as hidden text; when pinned to a host, also put it in the host's accessible name ("Inbox, 3 unread"). `live` makes it a polite `status`. Tone is never the only cue: words, an icon or the presence shape say it, in every context and in forced colours.

props.name: kind
props.description: `label`: one or two words. `count`: a number. `dot`: "something new", no number. `status`: a dot then words, no fill, for dense tables. `presence`: a person's availability, a shape per state. `icon`: one glyph in a filled circle for a state shown on an avatar (verified, approved, declined, warning), with `icon`, `tone` and `label`. Default `label`.

props.name: children
props.description: The words, for `label` and `status`: a state or a category, in sentence case, never truncated.

props.name: tone
props.description: Meaning through the status roles only; `accent` (default) for a category with no status. The words or the icon always say it too.

props.name: category
props.description: A category colour, 1-8 (`color.category.*`, Q44), for a badge that names a category (a project, a topic, a series), never a status. Replaces `tone`. Subtle: a quiet fill with a dot in the colour; strong: the colour as the fill. Keep one number per category everywhere it appears.

props.name: emphasis
props.description: `subtle` (default): a tint with coloured text. `strong`: a solid fill, for the one thing on the screen that needs attention.

props.name: icon
props.description: A leading icon for a `label` badge, such as a state's (open, closed), or the glyph of an `icon` badge. Decorative: the words or `label` carry the meaning.

props.name: showZero
props.description: `count`: show 0 instead of hiding the badge.

props.name: presence
props.description: `presence`: the state; each has its own shape, so colour is never the only cue.

props.name: label
props.description: What the badge means in words, for assistive technology: needed for `count`, `dot`, `presence` and `icon` ("3 unread", "New", "Busy", "Verified").

props.name: size
props.description: `s` (20 px) or `normal` (24 px). One size per context. Default `normal`. Dot, presence and icon badges follow their host: `s` 10 px with no glyph (shape only) on avatars of 40 px and less, `normal` 16 px, `l` 24 px on avatars of 96 px and more (an Avatar picks it).

props.name: anchor
props.description: Pins the badge to the top-end corner of this host (an Icon, an icon-only Button, an avatar).

props.name: overlap
props.description: With `anchor`: `round` hosts pull the badge in to their curve, `square` hosts sit it on the corner. Default `square`.

props.name: live
props.description: Announce changes politely (`role=status`), for a live count or status that matters to the reader.
